reviews.text:
I really like this product. It is easy to use and looks very nice on the skin.
Overall, I'm happy with this product and would buy it again. I recommend it if you want simple and pretty makeup.
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意呢件產品。佢好用又上到皮膚好靚。
整體嚟講我對呢件產品好滿意，會再回購。如果你想化簡單又靚嘅妝，我會推薦。

reviews.text: If you’re looking for a moderately light brown eyeliner, this is a very satisfying product. I always struggled to find a shade that wasn’t too dark, but I’ve finally settled on this one.
reviews.zh: 如果你搵緊中等淺色嘅啡色眼線筆，呢件係好滿意嘅產品。我一直搵唔到一支色號唔會太深嘅，終於搵到呢支啱用。

reviews.text: Very pretty cool pinky shade. The formula is very smooth and stains the lips slightly. Once the color fades, just add gloss over the stain for an easy touch up on the go.
reviews.zh: 好靚嘅冷調粉紅色。質地好滑，會輕微染唇。顏色退咗之後，直接補層 gloss 上去就可以簡單喺外面補妝。

reviews.text: Smells like sweet fruit candy. The colour is very natural on me but please note the tint is pretty sheer so your base lip colour will affect how the overall colour turns out. I love the finish at the start but unfortunately the dewy look doesn’t last as long as I hoped and I always need to apply additional lip balm because this does dry out my lips over time if I just have it on by itself.
reviews.zh: 聞落好似甜水果糖。喺我上面好自然，但要留意 tint 偏通透，所以你本身嘅唇色會影響最後上到嘅顏色。開頭嘅妝效我好鍾意，但可惜水光感冇我預期咁持久，而且如果單用嘅話戴耐咗會令嘴唇乾，所以我成日要補唇膏。

reviews.text: This tint gives a light pink strawberry colour to the lips but is fairly sheer. I like the natural but youthful look it gives my lips. The dewy finish doesn’t last that long though and I find it does dry out the lips over time so always need to bring lip balm with me.
reviews.zh: 呢個 tint 上到嘴唇係淺粉草莓色，但幾通透。我鍾意佢畀到我一種自然又青春嘅感覺。不過水光妝效唔算持久，而且戴耐咗會令嘴唇乾，所以我要成日帶住唇膏出街。

reviews.text: The name of the product led me to believe it would be more like a tinted lipgloss but it’s more like a liquid lipstick. It’s nice, i just don’t like the look of lipstick on myself.
reviews.zh: 產品個名令我以為會比較似有色潤唇膏，但佢其實比較似液態唇釉。產品本身唔錯，只係我自己唔鍾意唇膏嘅效果。

reviews.text: I really love how the new colors are pastels, unlike the older collection. Since both 03 and 10 look pretty identical to the online swatches, I had to compare between them, and to be honest I like the newer version better as it's not dark/bright and the shade berry chou looks pretty similar to the online picture. Overall I really love this lip tint but the glossy finish doesn't last all day only the color which still doesn't bother me at all I'm still quite happy with the purchase and would definitely recommend it to others.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意新色係粉彩色，同舊嗰批唔同。因為 03 同 10 對住網上試色圖睇起嚟幾乎一模一樣，所以我要比較一下，講真我比較鍾意新嗰個版本，佢唔深又唔鮮，而且 berry chou 呢個色號同網上圖片好相似。整體嚟講我真係好鍾意呢個唇 tint，不過光澤妝效撐唔到一整天，只係顏色仲喺度，但呢點完全唔困擾我，我仲係對呢次買得好滿意，一定會推薦畀其他人。

reviews.text:
Cherry Soda is such a gorgeous lively pink-red colour perfect for summery bright looks. 

In terms of formula, it stains pretty well but the gloss doesn't seem too last too long which is why I took off a star. It applies smoothly and easily though and has the loveliest fruit juice scent. It's non drying and feels very comfy on the lips.
reviews.zh:
Cherry Soda 係一款好靚、好有活力嘅粉紅色，啱晒夏天嘅明亮妝容。

質地方面，佢嘅染唇效果幾好，但 gloss 就似乎唔夠持久，所以我扣咗一粒星。唔過上唇好順好易推，而且有最靚嘅果汁香味。佢唔會乾嘴唇，搽上唇都好舒服。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
